cards.name: Grimhold Levies
cards.quote: March forth, children of darkness, to claim what is ours.

cards.name: Archers
cards.quote: Silently they watch, arrows nocked and ready, guardians of the shadows.

cards.name: Eastern Raiders
cards.quote: From the depths of darkness, we rise to cleanse the earth with fire and steel.

cards.name: Bannerlords
cards.quote: Their banners ride before them like dawn over a forest ridge, bright with the memory of elf-lords.

cards.name: Bears
cards.quote: The bears come with the old wrath of the wild.

cards.name: Beast of the Woods
cards.quote: The beast of the wood moves where no road is safe.

cards.name: Beasts
cards.quote: The beasts of the wild heed neither horn nor hedge.

cards.name: Blackshaft Men
cards.quote: With arrows black as night, we strike where hope dares to tread.

cards.name: Fallen Men
cards.quote: Fallen from grace, they wield darkness as their blade.

cards.name: Fallen Men Guard
cards.quote: They knew the towers of Old Kingdom and turned their backs on every light that once shone there.

cards.name: Bog Swarm
cards.quote: A foul mist rises from the marshes, cloaking the desolation.

cards.name: Hedge Wardens
cards.quote: A quiet watch is the first wall of the Thornhollow.

cards.name: Camel Riders
cards.quote: With the sun at their backs, they charge across the sands like a storm.

cards.name: Catapults
cards.quote: They hurl destruction, turning stone into a storm of chaos.

cards.name: Cave Goblins
cards.quote: Swarm like shadows, strike like venom.

cards.name: Cave Trolls
cards.quote: Crush all who stand against us, for we are relentless.

cards.name: Chariot Riders
cards.quote: The wheels of war thunder forward, cutting paths through the chaos.

cards.name: Conquerors of Deepdelve
cards.quote: Deepdelve yields only to those who remember the price of silence beneath the stone.

cards.name: Coastal Corsairs
cards.quote: From the shadows of Corsair Coast, they strike with blades dipped in treachery.

cards.name: Creatures of the Deeps
cards.quote: From the darkest depths, we rise to claim the light.

cards.name: Black Crows
cards.quote: From the shadows they come, cawing like harbingers of doom.

cards.name: Crossbow Orcs
cards.quote: Hidden in shadows, their bolts find the hearts of the unwary.

cards.name: Wine Country Bowmen
cards.quote: With arrows swift as the river's flow, we guard our land.

cards.name: Wine Country Infantry
cards.quote: Strong as the vines of our vineyards, we stand united in battle.

cards.name: Wine Country Mariners
cards.quote: With the wind at our backs, we sail towards glory.

cards.name: Wine Country Riders
cards.quote: Swift as the river, fierce as the lion, we ride forth.

cards.name: Dragon Hunters
cards.quote: When the sky burns, only the grim-willed stand close enough to answer.

cards.name: Firstblood Rangers
cards.quote: The Firstbloods keep the waste roads under secret watch.

cards.name: Wyldmoor Archers
cards.quote: With steady hands, they unleash arrows that sing of vengeance.

cards.name: Wyldmoor Warriors
cards.quote: Fierce and proud, they charge forth to reclaim their lost lands.

cards.name: Blackfort Orcs
cards.quote: Marching forth, the dark tide swells, hungry for plunder.

cards.name: Blackfort Sorcerers
cards.quote: With shadows as our allies, we weave spells to doom our foes.

cards.name: Dwarven Archers
cards.quote: A shaft loosed from the dark goes farther when the hand that sends it is steady.

cards.name: Dwarven Axemen
cards.quote: The axe is a plain answer, and the mountains have always favored plain answers.

cards.name: Dwarven Explorers
cards.quote: The deepest roads are found by the patient eye and the loyal lamp.

cards.name: Dwarven Miners
cards.quote: Every true hoard begins with a spark of iron against the old rock.

cards.name: Dwarven Pikeshields
cards.quote: A wall of spear and shield will stand where arrogance breaks itself.

cards.name: Dwarven Siege
cards.quote: What cannot be opened by hand may yet be persuaded by stone and fire.

cards.name: Eastlands Cataphracts
cards.quote: Armored like the mountain, unyielding as the dawn they herald.

cards.name: Elven Archers
cards.quote: Their shafts go out like whispers, and the woodland answers in silence.

cards.name: Elven Elk Riders
cards.quote: The elk run as if the earth itself had taken heart and chosen speed.

cards.name: Elven Fleet
cards.quote: Their keels cut the quiet water like moonlight drawn into a blade.

cards.name: Elven Scouts
cards.quote: They read the path before the path is made, and vanish before the answer comes.

cards.name: Elven Warriors
cards.quote: They fight as the deep wood fights, with patience, grace, and sudden wrath.

cards.name: Woodking's Guards
cards.quote: They stand where the trees grow oldest, and no lesser shadow passes unhindered.

cards.name: Tree Guardians
cards.quote: The shepherds of the forest are roused to wrath.

cards.name: Forest Orcs
cards.quote: The forest whispers our names, and violence is our song.

cards.name: Forest Spiders
cards.quote: We weave our webs of doom among the trees.

cards.name: Forest War Wolves
cards.quote: With the speed of shadows, we hunt our prey.

cards.name: Goldenwood Archers
cards.quote: From the mallorn boughs their arrows fall like silver rain on the unwise.

cards.name: Goat Riders
cards.quote: On the high paths, a stubborn goat and a stubborn dwarf are kin.

cards.name: Goblin Sappers
cards.quote: Our clever hands shall bring the walls of the enemy crumbling down.

cards.name: Goblins of Deepdelve
cards.quote: In the dark of Deepdelve, our laughter echoes like a death knell.

cards.name: Sunlands Archers
cards.quote: With eyes as sharp as their arrows, they guard the realm.

cards.name: Sunlands Infantry
cards.quote: Steadfast and true, they stand like stone against the tide.

cards.name: Cinderplain Militia
cards.quote: Rally to the call of the Eye; we fight for the dark lord.

cards.name: The Maw
cards.quote: The Hammer of the Underworld breaches walls with thunderous wrath.

cards.name: Half Elves
cards.quote: They belong to two histories, and carry the strength of both when the road grows dark.

cards.name: Half Orcs
cards.quote: Born of shadow, they revel in chaos and bloodshed.

cards.name: Half Trolls
cards.quote: Brute strength defines them, a terror to all who dare oppose.

cards.name: Greenmantle Hall Guards
cards.quote: In the halls beneath the trees, their spears keep the hush unbroken.

cards.name: Southlands Cavalry
cards.quote: Hooves pound the earth, echoing the call of conquest in the desert winds.

cards.name: Southlands Infantry
cards.quote: They stand as a wall of iron, resolute against the tides of war.

cards.name: Head Catapults
cards.quote: These monstrous machines bring down the fury of the siege.

cards.name: Hillmen
cards.quote: From the heights they descend, swift as the autumn storms.

cards.name: Halfling Archers
cards.quote: From the green hedges, a small bow may yet speak boldly.

cards.name: Halfling Slingers
cards.quote: The road will remember the sting of stones.

cards.name: Hobgoblins
cards.quote: Cunning and quick, they strike like a dagger in the dark.

cards.name: Hounds
cards.quote: With a howl that chills the heart, they hunt in packs, relentless and fierce.

cards.name: Steppe Warriors
cards.quote: Warriors of the cold north, their spirits burn bright with the fire of battle.

cards.name: Knights of Swanhold
cards.quote: Horns of the sea call us; we ride to glory.

cards.name: Ladders
cards.quote: With ladders raised, we breach the walls and bring the fight to our foes.

cards.name: Light Cavalry
cards.quote: Swift as the wind, they strike like lightning, leaving naught but echoes.

cards.name: Lore Seekers
cards.quote: They search the old places where knowledge still sleeps.

cards.name: Rimefolk
cards.quote: Born of ice and hunger, the Rimefolk strike where the frost bites deepest.

cards.name: Mangonels
cards.quote: With a great roar, we unleash fate upon our foes.

cards.name: Kingshall Guards
cards.quote: We are the shield of the Golden Hall, unyielding as the mountains.

cards.name: Men at Arms
cards.quote: With honor in their hearts, they march forth, champions of their lords.

cards.name: Men of Crossway
cards.quote: We are the watchful eyes and steady hands of the wilds.

cards.name: Miners
cards.quote: The stone yields nothing to haste, but it yields all to diligence.

cards.name: Mines
cards.quote: Beneath the earth, the echoes of pick and hammer resound.

cards.name: Ironmaw Garrison
cards.quote: Nothing passes the Black Gate that the Eye has not already named and numbered.

cards.name: Ashlands Wolf-riders
cards.quote: Saddle a warg and you have doubled your cruelty without halving your speed.

cards.name: Pale City Orcs
cards.quote: From the dead city they pour, bearing the dread of The Pale City.

cards.name: Weft Stair Guards
cards.quote: Silent sentinels of shadow, ever watchful and unyielding.

cards.name: Mounted Firstblood Rangers
cards.quote: On swift horses the Firstbloods pass like wind and shadow.

cards.name: Mounted Half-Orcs
cards.quote: With the speed of a wild storm, they charge into battle.

cards.name: Mounted Hillmen
cards.quote: Riders of the hills, they strike like thunder on the plains.

cards.name: Mounted Rangers of the Marches
cards.quote: The Rangers of the North ride as one at the edge of peril.

cards.name: Elephant Guard Spearmen
cards.quote: Their spears are as relentless as the desert sun.

cards.name: War Elephants
cards.quote: Titans of the battlefield, their rampage reshapes the very land.

cards.name: Firstborn Cavalry
cards.quote: The High Elves ride as if exile were a spur and memory a banner.

cards.name: Slave Fields Cavalry
cards.quote: With speed and fury, they ride like the storm itself.

cards.name: Slave Fields Reavers
cards.quote: The plains of Slave Fields remember no harvest but war; its people have grown to suit the yield.

cards.name: Warbred Trolls
cards.quote: Brutality incarnate, they charge with the wrath of a mountain's fall.

cards.name: Orcs
cards.quote: Savage and relentless, they surge like a tide of darkness.

cards.name: Kingsquay Fleet
cards.quote: Through stormy seas, our sails are the harbingers of hope.

cards.name: Pirates
cards.quote: The sea calls to us, and we answer with steel and sails.

cards.name: Rampart Catapults
cards.quote: Where the wall thunders, the road beyond grows quiet.

cards.name: Rangers
cards.quote: The Rangers hold the wild ways while others sleep.

cards.name: Rangers of the Greenmarch
cards.quote: Unseen, we tread the paths of shadow and light.

cards.name: Reclaimers of Lonely Mountain
cards.quote: The Lonely Mountain remembers every oath spoken for its return.

cards.name: Eastlands Corsairs
cards.quote: Swift as the wind, we strike like the very storms of the sea.

cards.name: Eastern Warbands
cards.quote: In the face of adversity, our resolve becomes our greatest weapon.

cards.name: Riders of Horse Plains
cards.quote: The thunder of our horses shall echo in victory.

cards.name: Rivermen
cards.quote: The river's song guides our oars as we defend our kin.

cards.name: Horse-lord Guards
cards.quote: Beneath Thornspire's shadow, once-proud riders stand watch in silence.

cards.name: Ruffians
cards.quote: Rough men, unasked-for, with clubs and cudgels, who take what they want and call it order.

cards.name: Ruin Spiders
cards.quote: From the ruins, we emerge, hungry and waiting.

cards.name: Ships
cards.quote: Upon the dark waters, timber and sail become the teeth of war.

cards.name: Snow Trolls
cards.quote: Frost and fury, we crush all beneath our icy might.

cards.name: Southlands Assassins
cards.quote: Silent shadows, they strike without warning from the sands.

cards.name: Southerners
cards.quote: With fierce hearts, they tread the sands, claiming the day as their own.

cards.name: Spawn of the Weaver
cards.quote: Born from shadow and hunger, we know no fear.

cards.name: Spearmen
cards.quote: Braced against the tide, they stand resolute, a wall of steel and valor.

cards.name: Stone Trolls
cards.quote: Stubborn as the mountains, we are the unforgiving.

cards.name: Swanhold Fleet
cards.quote: With the grace of swans, we sail upon the waters, ready for the call of destiny.

cards.name: Swordsmen
cards.quote: Swordsmen stand in line, and the dark breaks on them.

cards.name: The Golden Host
cards.quote: Bright as a summons at dawn, they gather where a kingdom means to answer.

cards.name: Torch Bearers
cards.quote: Flickering flames lead the way through the encroaching darkness.

cards.name: Tower Guards
cards.quote: Our vigilance is the fortress, our valor the blade.

cards.name: Tower Wardens
cards.quote: The wardens of Thornspire stand unshaken, for they guard more than stone.

cards.name: Trebuchets
cards.quote: With every stone cast, we hurl defiance at our foes.

cards.name: Corsair Coast Cavalry
cards.quote: Swift like the tide, they crash upon their foes with relentless fury.

cards.name: Corsair Coast Riders
cards.quote: The dark sails of Corsair Coast herald their arrival, swift and merciless.

cards.name: Undead
cards.quote: Once they lived, now they serve only darkness.

cards.name: Weftmarch Orcs
cards.quote: From the depths, we arise, relentless and unyielding.

cards.name: War Orcs
cards.quote: Steel-clad and relentless, we march as one unyielding force.

cards.name: Wainfolk Riders
cards.quote: With wheels that thunder and hearts that burn, we conquer the roads of men.

cards.name: War Trolls
cards.quote: Foul beasts of war, they trample all beneath their monstrous feet.

cards.name: Wardens of Old Kingshold
cards.quote: The wardens of Old Kingshold keep watch over a dead crown.

cards.name: War Wolf Riders
cards.quote: Swift as the wind, they hunt with teeth and claws unsheathed.

cards.name: War Wolves
cards.quote: Speed and hunger drive them, a dark storm of fangs and fury.

cards.name: Sunspire Wardens
cards.quote: Guardians of the White City, we defend against the dark.

cards.name: Wolves
cards.quote: The howl of the pack heralds the hunt's beginning.

cards.name: Nightwood Elves
cards.quote: Older than many songs, they move as if the woodland were their first home.

cards.name: Wood Trolls
cards.quote: In the heart of the forest, we are the giants that walk.

cards.name: Nightwood Archers
cards.quote: The forest teaches them patience, and patience is the deadliest bow.

cards.name: Nightwood Warriors
cards.quote: They fight with the rough grace of leaf and branch, and do not yield easily.

cards.name: Woodmen
cards.quote: The forest is our home, and we are its fiercest guardians.

cards.name: Woodmen Hunters
cards.quote: Silent as the falling leaf, we stalk our prey.

cards.name: Oldgrowth Woodfolk
cards.quote: We are the whispers of the forest, fierce in our silence.
